summary: A generative dub techno firmware, forked from AMB-1, that plays itself from power-on. You steer it rather than play it: pick a piece and scale, shape the mix and push the echo.
features: Chord stabs into tape echo, FM pings, sub bass, kick, hats and crackle
Eight-bar arrangement with breaks, fills and echo throws
Eight pieces; Endless, Song and Set modes with transitions
Arrangement page with mutes, solos, per-part sends and dub sirens
Five-lane 16-step drum pattern page and a 16-effect grid
Reports its screen to the FM-1 Screen Reader over USB
